title: Stale API Versioning
description: An autonomous devops agent remembers that Python 3.9 is the active runtime from a 2023 session, ignoring that it reached end-of-life and was superseded by Python 3.12.
incoming_interaction: Please configure our new CI workflow for the current production environment.
risk_analysis: Without temporal filtering, the agent provisions deprecated Python 3.9 containers, breaking modern dependency builds.

title: Contradictory Database Preferences
description: Two distinct sessions record conflicting architectural mandates: Session A mandated PostgreSQL, while Session B switched the company policy to SQLite.
incoming_interaction: Write the database initialization script for our new microservice.
risk_analysis: The agent hallucinates a hybrid Postgres/SQLite implementation or randomly picks the older Postgres schema due to lack of temporal reconciliation.

title: Postponed Product Deadline
description: Initial project kickoff recorded a release date of July 2026. A subsequent executive memo postponed launch to November 2026.
incoming_interaction: When is Project Apollo shipping, and how many sprints remain?
risk_analysis: Without temporal boundary checks, the agent reports a deadline that has already expired or computes incorrect sprint velocity.

title: Revoked Security Auth Scheme
description: A legacy token-based authentication mechanism was completely revoked in favor of mTLS OAuth.
incoming_interaction: Generate the client code to query the internal payments endpoint.
risk_analysis: The agent leaks or attempts to use revoked static tokens, causing authentication failures and potential audit violations.
